content.text: Off-by-one on the unit index: the loop divides but the reported unit lags because `i` is only advanced when the *next* iteration runs — the legacy file imported a UNIT_TABLE that starts at 'B', and my import resolves to the same table, so the real bug is my condition ordering. Checking the table shape via the test expectations vs. the loop: with UNIT_TABLE = ['B','KiB','MiB',...], 1048576 needs two divisions but `value >= 1024` stops after the second only if the comparison happens post-division. I'll restructure the loop so the index tracks the divisions performed.
